approved_baseline.reuse: Reuse committed source-backed approval; central Dockerfile/workflow hashes checked against baseline evidence before editing.

central_boundary.build: Go 1.26 Alpine; CGO_ENABLED=0; go build ./cmd/server/; linux/amd64 + linux/arm64
central_boundary.runtime: Alpine 3.22.0; existing configured auth-dir, provider and storage endpoints
central_boundary.change: Only workflow source SHA changes (681ce41 → f7ae8fe); Dockerfile and build parameters unchanged.

coverage.test_scope: Path/blob verification only; _test.go excluded from central build, no auxiliary test reading needed.
coverage.source_integrity: Complete locally generated non-test diff read (25,517 lines); go.mod/go.sum blob SHAs verified unchanged.

semantic_findings: --login-proxy flag stores proxy_url into the credential config for OAuth login flow; does not affect runtime request routing to upstream AI providers.
DeferredAPICapture middleware: 32MiB request / 512KiB response limits, error-only logging mode; no new external destination.

/v1/tunnel WebSocket endpoint added (wstunnel.Hub); apiKey-isolated realm, reservation-gated registration, 64MiB data frame limit, 4096-byte control frame limit; all traffic stays within the existing auth boundary.
ReadMetadataHomeCloak and related helpers read from in-memory metadata maps only; no network calls.
marshalReasoningReplayRawJSONArray: encoding/json replaced by ojson for replay cache; format-compatible, no new I/O.
PeekAntigravityReasoningReplayItems*: read-only path, no tombstone creation.
Home client heartbeat: stricter PONG validation (payload-less only); no new destinations.
SanitizeAntigravity/SanitizeDevin: in-memory config normalization, no I/O.
WebSocket keepalive refactored to lastHeartbeat-based absolute deadline; in-memory timing only.
wstunnel/hub.go: multi-tenant Hub with apiKey-isolated realms; connection requires valid reservation; control queue overflow closes the peer cleanly.
conductor_cooldown.go: forceCooldownSeeded/forceCooldownUntil/credQuotaForceUntil merge in-memory; no external propagation.
conductor_persistence.go: mergeRuntimeCooldownSaveDelta writes delta back to existing local KV store; ModelStates Clone prevents shared-reference mutation.

conductor_selection.go/oauth_model_alias.go: OAuth alias routing uses canonicalModelLookupKey (case-insensitive); publishOAuthModelAliasAndReconcileStates replaces atomic Store; purely in-memory reconciliation.
cooldown_state.go: CooldownSignals/ForceCooldownUntil persistence fields write to existing local KV store; no new external destinations.
quota_signals.go: rejectedClaudeSignalsForCooldown filters anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* headers from upstream response; no new HTTP requests.

scheduler.go: rebuildAuths preserves model shard and mixed cursors across config reloads; claudeCooldownSummaryLocked is read-only in-memory; newModelCooldownErrorForCandidates passes Anthropic header subset to error response.
scheduler_weighted.go (new, 34 lines): pickWeightedPoolLocked delegates to WeightedRoundRobinSelector.reservePoolScoped; pure in-memory accounting.

selector.go refactored: WeightedRoundRobinSelector uses weightedPoolState with epoch isolation and pending reservation; SafeResponseHeaders() outputs only Retry-After; Headers() appends Anthropic-Ratelimit-Unified-* headers derived from upstream response subset only; appendClaudeUnifiedHeaders operates on string/HTTP header maps with no I/O.

selector_weighted.go (new, 922 lines): weightedPoolState/weightedReservation/reservePoolScoped/reserveDynamicPoolLocked/ForgetAuth; pure in-memory weighted round-robin accounting; no network/file/syscall.
types.go: forceCooldownUntil/credQuotaForceUntil/forceCooldownSeeded fields are json:"-" (runtime-only); cooldownSignals/cooldownEvaluated are unexported in-memory fields.
executor/context.go: localWebsocketTurnTracker is an atomic bool in context value; no I/O.
service_config.go: newRoutingSelectorWithExisting reuses existing WeightedRoundRobinSelector instance on strategy unchanged; no new network calls.
service_executors.go: ClaudeExecutor.WithConfig reuses existing executor instance; no new network calls.

session/claude_thread.go (new, 107 lines): RememberClaudeThreadAuth writes authID string to existing KV store (kvstore.KVSetNXBestEffort, TTL 24h); ClaudeThreadAuth reads from same KV store; key format claude:thread-auth:v1:<hash>:<hash>; no new external destinations.
usage/home_selection.go (new, 37 lines): HomeSelection is a context value with immutable copy semantics; no I/O.
usage/manager.go: HomeSelection field attached to existing usage record pipeline; no new external destinations.
pluginabi/types.go: ErrorCode* constants and CredentialScoped field added; pure constant/struct extension; no network calls.
limitations: Static malicious-code/dependency increment only; no vulnerability/correctness/performance/test assessment.
No upstream clone/install/build/execution/tests/scanning during review; approved publication CI is separate.
Native plugins, external Home, upstream binaries and full dependency/toolchain implementations not newly approved; provenance:false unchanged.
